end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping, and slanting straight lines.
Used objects such as stumps, goal posts, slides, and the ground to explain line directions.
Identified straight versus curved lines correctly in 2 attempts.
A V or zigzag shape was called curved once; this was not corrected after the last time it appeared.
end.parentNote: Om practised naming standing, sleeping, and slanting lines and used familiar examples to explain the directions. They correctly noted that a slanting line can still be straight and explained this using a slide. There was one mix-up between a cornered V shape and a curved line, and it was not revisited after the last mention. At home, ask Om to sort drawings into straight, curved, standing, sleeping, and slanting groups, reminding them that a corner is not a smooth curve.
